input.prompt: A small intimate round table of ten to twelve senior executives leaning in, genuinely engaged in conversation, no laptops, no lanyards, warm low light, crystal glasses, subtle pink and gold neon glow on the walls behind. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings.
